run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the next power of 2 greater than or equal to a given integer n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets to verify correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a different algorithm for finding the next power of 2
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses bitwise operations to check if n is already a power of 2
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns n if it is a power of 2, otherwise the next higher power of 2
